original_test_intent: Validate eight M-suffixed UBB GPU temperature records, TEMP_UBB_GPU0M through TEMP_UBB_GPU7M, with their exact owner-defined sensing meaning and consistent identity, value and state across complete IB/OOB SDR, Sensor List and BMC Web views.
original_method: The owner defines what M denotes and maps every M channel to a physical GPU/module and measurement source; automation then passively enumerates all eight exact records and reconciles them against approved condition-specific criteria.
manual_activity: The platform/thermal owner defines the M suffix, binds GPU0M–GPU7M to physical modules and sensing points, and approves limits and Web entries. No relationship to unsuffixed sensors is assumed.
required_inputs: Authoritative M-suffix definition and UBB assembly/revision
GPU0M–GPU7M population and physical position to module serial/UUID/BDF map
Measurement-source definition for each M channel and relationship to unsuffixed GPU sensors
Exact SDR entity/name/description and Sensor List/Web mapping per member
Units, scaling, tolerance, freshness and unavailable semantics
Condition-specific normal ranges and enabled thresholds with load, power, cooling and ambient context
Same-target IB/OOB identity and BMC/SDR/UBB/GPU specification revisions
Secret-safe complete collectors and independent GPU/thermal/BMC recovery
safety_requirements: Do not expand M into an unapproved term or reuse unsuffixed channel criteria
Enumerate GPU0M through GPU7M as eight exact records rather than one literal tilde name
Bind each reading to a stable module identity, physical position and measurement source
Preserve complete IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List before derived filters and capture Web evidence
Do not start workload, reset GPUs, alter power/fans/thresholds, reset BMC or clear logs
Stop on unknown M semantics, topology mismatch, missing/stale/invalid reading, thermal fault or path disagreement; no automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Verify exact row/variant and owner-approved M semantics
Verify UBB population and stable GPU/module identity on the same IB/OOB target
Collect complete SDR and Sensor List plus eight exact M-suffixed records without writes
Prepare Web parity and passive GPU/XID/power/fan/SEL context
Perform no inference of M, workload/control action or final verdict
engineer_actions: Define M and its relation, if any, to unsuffixed GPU temperature channels
Approve per-index module and measurement-source mapping
Provide ranges, thresholds and N/A policy
Review eight-channel cross-path evidence and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Incomplete: the literal GPU0~7M token need not resolve to eight records, only OOB exact query plus truncated SDR is proposed, and Sensor List/Web/IB evidence and secret-safe authentication are absent.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After owner approval of M semantics, use secret-safe same-target IB/OOB sessions to retain complete SDR and Sensor List, resolve each GPU0M–GPU7M record separately, and compare BMC Web read-only evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The M suffix, indices 0–7, four command views, Web checkpoint and 3/3-minute estimates are retained without interpreting M.

modernized_recommendation.status: REQUIRES M-CHANNEL DEFINITION, PHYSICAL IDENTITY AND THERMAL-CRITERIA PACKAGE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use an eight-row matrix joining M-channel name, UBB position, GPU serial/UUID/BDF, sensor source, approved limit and each management view.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes the unexplained suffix and channel provenance explicit before collection.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Unsuffixed GPU temperatures cannot stand in for M channels unless the owner documents an exact relationship and distinct acceptance purpose.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: If M represents a derived, memory, module or mirrored value, applying junction-temperature limits could yield a technically invalid PASS or FAIL.

project_override_considerations: If M channels are aliases, mirrored values or optional by SKU, the owner must define uniqueness and N/A rules; identical numeric values alone do not prove correct identity.
expected_evidence: Approved M-suffix definition and relation to unsuffixed channels
Eight-index UBB position and GPU serial/UUID/BDF inventory
Per-index measurement source, SDR/entity description and Web mapping
Complete redacted IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List outputs
Eight mapped readings/states with units, freshness, conditions and approved limits
Web evidence, passive GPU/XID/power/fan/ambient/SEL context and same-target proof
No-write/no-clear audit, statuses, hashes and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently names TEMP_UBB_GPU0~7M, but does not define M. That omission is a required project input rather than authority to reinterpret the source.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The eight-channel passive comparison is identifiable and can proceed after the owner supplies M semantics, mapping and limits under ED-36.

review_improvement: Separates the M-suffixed family from adjacent unsuffixed sensors and requires explicit suffix meaning, stable hardware identity and measurement provenance before any SPEC comparison.
independent_technical_reasoning: A one-character suffix can distinguish a different die, memory, module, maximum or mirrored telemetry path; its sampling point and allowable range may therefore differ materially from the unsuffixed channel. Cross-view name parity is insufficient until every M record is tied to a physical module and defined source.
